name: OBR-Bench
description: The code behind OBR-Bench, an evaluation resource for oracle bone fragment rejoining. This deposit contains the scripts only. It builds the resource from three openly licensed datasets, which are not redistributed here: OBFI (10.5281/zenodo.10849444, CC BY 4.0), OBID-ACR (10.5281/zenodo.17749727, CC BY 4.0) and OBIMD v1.1 (10.5281/zenodo.18675664, MIT). Download those, then run build_manifest.py followed by build_release.py to regenerate the benchmark deterministically: the declared candidate pool of 5,374 fragments, the labelled pairs and the assemblies derived from them, the join-disjoint splits, the catalogue-scoped candidate pool definitions, the OBIMD/OBID-ACR concordance, the character-level join table, the conversion table and the reference baseline. calibrate.py is standalone and needs only NumPy and SciPy. It converts a reported balanced pairwise score into retrieval performance against a pool of any size: python calibrate.py --auc 0.95 --pool 5374 All scripts are released under the MIT licence. Accompanies: Yang, W. and Yang, J., An open retrieval benchmark for oracle bone fragment rejoining (submitted, 2026).
